text: Noah starts reception on Thursday. Elena says he's been practising with his book bag all week. Text her that afternoon to ask how the first day went.

Hiroshi's dad had a fall on Sunday and broke his wrist. He's driving up to Leeds tomorrow morning to stay with him for a few days. His dad lives on his own since Hiroshi's mum passed, so the plan is to sort out a cleaner and maybe a meal delivery before he comes back. Hiroshi sounded worried but calm. Ask him at the weekend how his dad's getting on.
Viewing for the flat on Carlton Road is Saturday at 11. Bring the tape measure and ask about the boiler.
Fatima graduates on the 14th at 2pm. Her parents are flying in from Lahore the day before. I should get her a card and something small, maybe a nice pen.
Ryan and Catalina have finally exchanged contracts. They move into the new place in Bristol on the 3rd and are having people round the weekend after.
Teresa's little girl Lola has chickenpox, so Teresa's off work all week. Don't forget to drop some colouring books round.
Emre's son Tunde got his GCSE results this morning. Two 9s and a 7 in maths. Emre is beside himself.
Jamal is moving to Glasgow for the new job. Last day here is the 31st, then he drives up the next day with his brother Anil.
Graham has his knee operation on Monday at 8am. Remind me to ring him on Tuesday evening, once he's had a chance to sleep it off.

Bogdan's mum is back in hospital. He sounded exhausted on the phone and said he's not sleeping much. She went in on Tuesday night with breathing trouble and they're keeping her in until at least Friday. His sister Catalina is flying over from Bucharest the day after tomorrow to take over for a bit. Should offer to walk their dog while he's at the hospital.
Tadhg is coeliac, so no bakery stuff when he comes over.
Moira's grandson Colm started secondary school last week. She says he's already lost his blazer twice.
Zainab has her driving test on Friday at 3pm and she's really nervous about it. Text her good luck that morning, and then ask how it went afterwards.

Blessing's cat Biscuit has gone missing. She's put posters up all over the estate and is checking the shelter tomorrow. He slipped out on Monday evening when the window cleaner came and hasn't been seen since. She's not eating properly and keeps going out at night with a torch. Remind me to share her post on the local Facebook group tonight, and to check in with her on Thursday.
Erin is moving back in with her parents for a bit while she looks for a flat in Manchester. Says it's fine, but I think she's finding it hard.
Leon broke his collarbone at rugby on Saturday. He's in a sling for six weeks and can't drive, so his girlfriend Matilda is ferrying him about.
Victor's daughter has her ballet exam on the 22nd at half 10. He mentioned she wants a proper dance bag afterwards, which could be a nice present for her birthday in December.
Need to send Antoine the estate agent's number before his viewing next Wednesday.
Giulia's mum has been diagnosed with shingles. Giulia is flying to Rome on Thursday morning to help out and is back the following Tuesday.
Collected the keys today. Electrics man comes Monday at 9, broadband the day after.
Hoang finished his PhD viva yesterday. Minor corrections only. They're celebrating at his place on Saturday night.
Yasmin has a scan on Wednesday at 4.15 and she's been really anxious about it. I'm driving her there and waiting with her.

Eduardo Santos, aka Eddie, is the new neighbour in number 12. Moved down from Newcastle with his wife and two boys. Works as a paramedic. The older boy is starting at St Mary's next week and the younger one is in Year 2. Eddie said they don't know anyone round here yet, so it'd be nice to invite them over for a drink once they're unpacked. His wife is called Teresa, I think.
Fang mentioned her son is sitting his eleven plus on the 12th. She's more stressed than he is. Must ask her the next day how he got on.
Aleksander and Giulia's housewarming has been called off because the sale fell through at the last minute. They're staying in the rental until spring.
Dr Novak said Elena's dad should be home by the weekend if his bloods are okay tomorrow morning.
Noah's first swimming lesson was on Saturday. Elena says he cried the whole time but wants to go back. Ask her next week if it went any better.
Ryan is allergic to nuts. Keep that in mind for the leaving do.
Hiroshi loves vintage film cameras. Has about thirty of them in a cabinet in the hallway.

Catalina's brother Victor is starting university in Edinburgh in two weeks. Her mum is driving him up the Friday before and staying the weekend to help him settle in. Catalina says he's acting cool but has asked her about laundry three times. I should send him a little care package once he's in, maybe with some biscuits and a laundry guide as a joke.
Call the letting agent about the deposit. It's been six weeks.
Emre has a hospital appointment on Monday at 2pm about his back. He's been in pain for months and is worried it's a disc problem. Check in with him that evening.
Lola lost her first tooth today! Teresa sent a photo of the gap.

Tunde's graduation is on the 9th at 11am in the cathedral. Emre and his wife are going, and they're all going out for lunch afterwards. Tunde has already got a job lined up at an engineering firm in Birmingham and starts there two weeks after. Emre says he's dropped hints about wanting a decent watch for the new job, so they might go for that.
Matilda is moving to Lisbon in January. She's renting her flat out and says she can't wait to leave the rain behind.

Jamal said his daughter is struggling at her new school. Not making friends yet and crying before drop-off most mornings. He and his wife have a meeting with her teacher on Thursday at 3.30. Their old school in Leicester was tiny, so it's a big change for her, and she misses her best friend loads. Jamal is trying to set up a video call between them at the weekend. Don't forget to ask him how the meeting went the next day.
Graham's wife Moira is retiring at Christmas after thirty years at the library. There's a do for her on the 19th.
Anil has his first day at the new firm on Monday. Send him a quick message on Sunday night to wish him luck.
Teresa Popescu's son is starting nursery a week after half term. She is dreading it more than he is.
Blessing told me Mrs Adeyemi from the church is in hospital with pneumonia. Visiting hours are 2 to 4. Maybe go on Sunday afternoon with Blessing.

Erin's flat viewing in Didsbury on Saturday at 10 went well. She's put in an offer and should hear back by Monday. It's a two-bed above a bakery, close to the tram, and the second room would work as an office for her design work. If it goes through she wants to move before Christmas. Need to text her on Monday afternoon to see if she got it.
Bogdan is a huge Arsenal fan and plays five-a-side on Wednesdays. Hates being called Bogey.
Doctor's appointment moved to Thursday at 9.40, so I'll pick up my prescription afterwards.
Colm's dad has been off work since the accident. Moira says he's doing physio twice a week and getting stronger, but he's frustrated.
Tadhg and his partner Fang have a baby due in March. They're house hunting now because the flat only has one bedroom. They have a viewing tomorrow morning in Clontarf and another on Saturday at 12.

Victor said his mum's chemo starts next Tuesday. He's taking the day off to go with her, and his sister is covering the week after. Remind me to text Victor that evening, and maybe take a lasagne round at the weekend.

Ryan mentioned Catalina is training for the Cardiff half marathon in March. She's been out every morning at 6. It's her first one since she hurt her ankle last year, and she's nervous it'll flare up again. Ryan's planning to drive down with their kids to cheer her on at the finish, and they've booked a hotel for the night before.
Need to book the van for the 28th and cancel the gas at the old flat the day before.
Antoine Dubois has moved into his new flat in Lyon. His dog Pepper hated the journey but is settling in. He's doing a little dinner on Friday at 8 for a few friends.
Hoang's daughter Zainab got into Cambridge! Results came through this morning. He's taking the family out for dinner tonight.
Fatima's dad is recovering from a mild stroke. He's home now and walking with a frame.
Yasmin finally got her scan results back: all clear. She was over the moon.
Spent the whole evening packing boxes. Kitchen done, bedroom tomorrow, books at the weekend.
Eduardo's wife Giulia is pregnant with their third. Due in May. He says the boys are hoping for a sister.

Uncle Graham is having a hip replacement on the 4th. Mum is going to stay with him for the week afterwards. I must phone him the day before to wish him well, and ask Mum the next weekend how he's coping.
Leon says Noah's mum is selling the house and moving to Spain next summer. Noah's not thrilled.
Aleksander's son passed his driving theory test today, first time. Practical is booked for December.
Matilda keeps hinting that she'd love one of those heated blankets for her new place. Could be a good housewarming gift.
Elena Rossi works as a midwife at the Royal. Grew up in Turin. Two kids, Noah and Leon.
Lovely chat with Blessing. Nothing much new.
